title: Norm Plugin Shape V2 Tree Purity Retrofit
description: Migrate the 📕️norm plugin's 107 constitutional crates (1 manifest/artifact bundle + 1 plugin-level 🫀️core module + 15 apps × (facade + ⚙️engine + 🗣️dsl + 🔧️op + 🎒️pack + 📡️protocol + 🖱️ui)) into ONE crate `semio-s-plugin-norm` at ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/📦️packages/🦀️rust following the crate-consolidation-and-taxonomy-restructure recipe (TEMPLATE.md in ticket 26/08/05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE). 15 apps: din16798, din18599, din4108, en1990..en1999, iso16757, vdi3805 — compliance-standard document apps, ~18k lines total. Target taxonomy: 15 artifacts (one per standard) + 15 apps + a plugin-level 🫀️core for the shared cross-artifact machinery currently in 🔨️modules/🫀️core. Preserve all [package.metadata.*] tables verbatim from the old bundle crate (playground ports for all variants, component package id, aliases). Wire-format-diff proof required per app. Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, root 📜️script.ts, registry script, launch.json, AGENTS.md, or any other plugin — end with a registrar handoff block.
summary:
Shape V2 Tree Purity retrofit for 📕️norm, on top of its already-closed V1 migration (same ticket, reopened per the master doc's convention). Purely mechanical — zero logic/behavior change, zero test-count drift.

FILES MOVED:
- ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/📦️lib.rs -> ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (the V1->V2 entry-file relocation)
- ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🦀️config.rs -> ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs (sibling-variant fold, Shape V2 point 2)
- ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🦀️app.rs -> ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🖥️app-surface/🦀️component.rs (sibling-variant fold)

CARGO.TOML: [lib] path "../../📦️lib.rs" -> "📦️lib.rs" (same-dir, per V2).

PATH-STRING FIXES in the relocated lib.rs (via ticket-local 🛠️shape-v2-fix-paths.ts, applying the CORRECTED rule from master.md's "SHAPE V2 RETROFIT CORRECTION" note): 258 leaf #[path] strings prefixed with "../../" to climb back to the owner-root tree; all 109 grouping-module #[path = "."] resets left exactly as "." (unprefixed) — verified this distinction is right via a REAL compile, not just inspection, per the correction note's explicit warning.

DATA/DOCS: already at the owner root before this retrofit (📚️examples/, AGENTS.md) — nothing was buried in the tree or in 📦️packages, so no relocation was needed there; confirmed via a find sweep (zero hits below maxdepth 1).

VERIFICATION (all real, all green):
1. cargo check --manifest-path (native) — clean.
2. cargo check --manifest-path --target wasm32-wasip2 — clean.
3. cargo clippy --manifest-path --all-targets -- -D warnings — clean (norm itself zero warnings).
4. DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools cargo test --manifest-path --lib — 894/894 passed, EXACT match to the pre-retrofit baseline recorded in this ticket's 🧪️test-baseline-before.txt — zero drift. Wire-format proof: the pinned-hex wire guard tests are part of the 894 and all still pass.
5. Ticket-local taxonomy audit (🛠️taxonomy-audit.ts, updated to point at the new lib.rs location): "✅️ taxonomy tree clean: 📕️norm" — 258 component files, 15 artifacts, 15 apps, zero dangling #[path], zero misnamed leaves, zero retired "protocol" segments, lib.rs stays wiring-only.

SURPRISE / DEVIATION FROM THE STANDARD RECIPE: root `cargo metadata`/the real registry `check` command are both blocked repo-wide — metadata by an unrelated leftover `[workspace]` verification overlay in ➗️mathematical's Cargo.toml (another plugin's directory, not touchable per this ticket's constraints), and the registry catalog by an unrelated concurrent in-flight 🎪️demonstrator migration (confirmed via a scratch diff, 🛠️registry-staleness-diff.ts: norm's own registry entry — pluginId/cratePath/packageName/wasmOut/contributes/consumes — is byte-identical before and after this retrofit; the only diff is demonstrator's cratePath). Worked around by adding a temporary `[workspace]` verification overlay to norm's OWN Cargo.toml (TEMPLATE.md §3's trick, scoped only to this plugin) and verifying via `--manifest-path` in isolation — then fully removed the overlay + its nested target/+Cargo.lock before handoff (confirmed via grep: zero remaining "TEMPORARY VERIFICATION OVERLAY"/"[workspace]" hits in norm's Cargo.toml). Did not touch mathematical's leftover overlay or run the registry `generate` command (both out of scope / forbidden).

Registrar handoff: EMPTY, as expected for a retrofit — root Cargo.toml's member line (path to 📦️packages/🦀️rust) never moved, and a repo-wide grep confirms nothing outside the plugin ever referenced the old owner-root 📦️lib.rs path.

Files touched: ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/📦️lib.rs (removed, moved), ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/📦️packages/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs (new), ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml (edited: [lib] path), ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🦀️config.rs (removed, moved), ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🎚️config/🦀️component.rs (new), ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🦀️app.rs (removed, moved), ✏️s/🔌️plugins/📕️norm/🫀️core/🖥️app-surface/🦀️component.rs (new), plus ticket-local scratch: 🛠️shape-v2-fix-paths.ts, 🛠️registry-staleness-diff.ts, 🧪️shape-v2-retrofit-verification-log.txt, and 🛠️taxonomy-audit.ts (updated in place for the new lib.rs location).
